title: BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) message
summary: BGP is the routing protocol of the Internet. BGP messages are carried over TCP (port 179). Four message types: OPEN (1), UPDATE (2), NOTIFICATION (3), KEEPALIVE (4). All BGP messages: 16-byte marker (all 0xFF), 2-byte length, 1-byte type.

ext.summary: BGP is the routing protocol of the Internet. BGP messages are carried over TCP (port 179). Four message types: OPEN (1), UPDATE (2), NOTIFICATION (3), KEEPALIVE (4). All BGP messages: 16-byte marker (all 0xFF), 2-byte length, 1-byte type.

structure.meaning: All 0xFF (authentication, or just a marker in modern BGP).
Total message length including header (19-4096 bytes).
Version (1), My Autonomous System (2/4 bytes), Hold Time (2), BGP Identifier (4), Optional Parameters (variable: type, length, value).
Withdrawn Routes Length (2) + Withdrawn Routes (variable) + Total Path Attribute Length (2) + Path Attributes (variable) + NLRI (variable).

ext.example_hex: ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff 00 13 04
notes: Path attributes: ORIGIN, AS_PATH, NEXT_HOP, MULTI_EXIT_DISC, LOCAL_PREF, ATOMIC_AGGREGATE, AGGREGATOR, COMMUNITIES, MP_REACH_NLRI (IPv6), ... .
BGP route selection: highest LOCAL_PREF, shortest AS_PATH, lowest ORIGIN, lowest MED, eBGP over iBGP, lowest IGP metric, lowest router ID.
BGP is the protocol that holds the Internet together (inter-domain routing).
